WITH joined_data AS (
  SELECT a.*, p.bats
  FROM appearances a
  JOIN player p ON a.player_id = p.player_id
),
group_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    bats,
    COUNT(*) as count
  FROM joined_data
  GROUP BY bats
),
totals AS (
  SELECT 
    COUNT(*) as total_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT bats) as num_groups
  FROM joined_data
)
SELECT 
  gc.bats,
  gc.count,
  CAST(gc.count AS REAL) / t.total_count as fraction,
  CAST(gc.count AS REAL) / (CAST(t.total_count AS REAL) / t.num_groups) as divided_by_avg
FROM group_counts gc
CROSS JOIN totals t
